name: @victorhaine/p2p-transfer
description: End-to-end encrypted WebRTC file transfer with a CLI, browser client, and tiny signaling server.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-build-toolchain-dependencies.mjs && node --import tsx scripts/check-crypto-dependencies.mjs && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-node', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('dist-web', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.chmodSync('dist-node/cli/index.js', 0o755); fs.chmodSync('dist-node/server/index.js', 0o755)" && vite build && node scripts/write-web-asset-manifest.mjs
scripts.verify:local: pnpm check:install-state && pnpm security:build-toolchain && pnpm security:dependencies && pnpm rebuild @roamhq/wrtc esbuild && pnpm security:build-toolchain && pnpm security:dependencies && pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm smoke:native && pnpm smoke:packed
scripts.verify:release: pnpm check:install-state && pnpm security:build-toolchain && pnpm security:dependencies && pnpm rebuild @roamhq/wrtc esbuild && pnpm security:build-toolchain && pnpm security:dependencies && pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test:unit && pnpm smoke:native && pnpm smoke:packed && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:browser && pnpm security:audit && pnpm security:signatures && node scripts/write-release-notes.mjs --check && pnpm smoke:release-artifact
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm test:browser
scripts.test:platform: node --import tsx --test test/authority.test.ts test/browser-file-names.test.ts test/browser-operation-policy.test.ts test/chunks.test.ts test/cli-error-redaction.test.ts test/cli-json-policy.test.ts test/cli-timers.test.ts test/client-retry-policy.test.ts test/close-reason.test.ts test/control-waiter.test.ts test/cpace-vectors.test.ts test/crypto-dependencies.test.ts test/data-channel-policy.test.ts test/exit-codes.test.ts test/format.test.ts test/hash.test.ts test/http-hardening.test.ts test/http-probe.test.ts test/ice.test.ts test/install-state-verifier.test.ts test/interrupt.test.ts test/native-webrtc-dependencies.test.ts test/output-safety.test.ts test/package-info.test.ts test/prepair-attempts.test.ts test/privacy-surface.test.ts test/rate-limit.test.ts test/receive-queue-policy.test.ts test/request-headers.test.ts test/security-headers.test.ts test/security.test.ts test/server-capacity.test.ts test/server-config.test.ts test/server-ice-policy.test.ts test/server-policy.test.ts test/server-url.test.ts test/session-expiry.test.ts test/signal-queue.test.ts test/signaling-completion-policy.test.ts test/signaling.test.ts test/static-path.test.ts test/transfer-receiver.test.ts test/transfer-sender.test.ts test/web-asset-integrity.test.ts test/ws-backpressure.test.ts
